lobbies_active_chat_uq.name: lobbies_active_chat_uq
lobbies_active_chat_uq.where: "lobbies"."chat_id" is not null and "lobbies"."chat_closed_at" is null

moderation_cases_decision_chk.name: moderation_cases_decision_chk
moderation_cases_decision_chk.value: "moderation_cases"."decision" is null or ("moderation_cases"."kind" = 'reports' and "moderation_cases"."decision" in ('reports_confirmed','reports_dismissed')) or ("moderation_cases"."kind" = 'not_held' and "moderation_cases"."decision" in ('meetup_held','host_flaked')) or ("moderation_cases"."kind" = 'appeal' and "moderation_cases"."decision" in ('appeal_approved','appeal_rejected'))

notifications_subject_chk.name: notifications_subject_chk
notifications_subject_chk.value: "notifications"."lobby_id" is not null or "notifications"."case_id" is not null

users_creation_block_chk.name: users_creation_block_chk
users_creation_block_chk.value: "users"."lobby_creation_blocked" = ("users"."creation_blocked_reason" is not null) and ("users"."creation_blocked_reason" is null) = ("users"."creation_blocked_at" is null)
